limitations: Historical membership and current industry mapping are survivor-conditioned; delisted-company coverage is incomplete.
SEC filing dates are reconstructed; exact publication times and historical restatement availability are incomplete.
Only about five years of feature history. Monthly annual outcomes overlap substantially.
15th/50th/85th model quantiles are estimates; measured coverage can differ from the nominal 70% interval.
Analyst revision history and dated earnings-call signals are unavailable and are not fabricated.
Valuation scenarios are explicit assumptions shared by all candidates, not predicted revenue/EPS growth or probability-weighted targets.
Five stocks are a concentrated research shortlist. No calibrated win probability or demonstrated trading edge is claimed.

return_definition: Total return including dividend adjustments; next session adjusted open to close 252 sessions later. Estimates are before costs and tax.
selection: Equal-weighted four-pillar composite (25% volatility-scaled 6M relative-strength percentile, 25% revenue-growth percentile, 25% ROE percentile, 25% operating-cash-flow-yield percentile) inside the quality cohort, requiring positive 6M relative strength vs QQQ, trailing P/E <= 40x (earnings yield >= 2.5%), and revenue growth <= 100%; maximum two per sector, one per industry, trailing daily correlation <= 0.80 with >=126 paired observations. Fewer than five if constraints prevent filling slots. Experimental model estimates do not determine this ranking.
universe: Liquid US stocks, cap >= $2B, revenue growth >=5%, positive operating/net income, cash/profit >=0.7, ROE 5–80%, equity/assets >=5%, operating margin >=5%, liabilities/assets <=80%, annualised volatility <=65%, fresh reconciled accounts. Financials, REITs and unknown sectors excluded.

validation.note: Monthly 12-month cohorts overlap. These are reconstructed, survivor-conditioned diagnostics, not independent trials or a live track record. Range coverage is measured, not guaranteed.
